The '''Elom system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]].
